close_reason: All four API shape fixes complete: q13 (SignatureVerifier return type), o76 (TrustAnchor shape), b9z (RevocationChecker error type), e9v (Display+Error traits). cargo clippy -D warnings passes.
description:
The four published crates have design defects in their public API that must be corrected before any implementation is written. All are breaking changes. Since 0.1.0 was a namespace-grab with no real users, the plan is to yank 0.1.0 across all four crates and publish corrected shapes as 0.2.0-alpha.1 once this epic is complete.

Issues in this epic:
- PKIX-e9v: Add Display + std::error::Error to all Error types
- PKIX-b9z: RevocationChecker returns pkix_path::Result but no Revoked variant exists
- PKIX-q13: SignatureVerifier::verify_signature return type forces wrong error index
- PKIX-o76: TrustAnchor requires full Certificate; should accept (subject, SPKI) directly

Acceptance: cargo clippy -D warnings passes, cargo test passes, all four API changes are in place, 0.1.0 yanked, 0.2.0-alpha.1 published.
title: Epic: Fix API shape before any implementation
